_comment: Pinned inputs for tools/pi-image/build.py. Bump these deliberately; build.py refuses anything that does not match.

base_image.name: 2026-10-06-raspios-trixie-arm64
base_image.description: Raspberry Pi OS (64-bit) with desktop, Debian 13 trixie, released 2026-10-06

mtools._comment: Used to edit the FAT boot partition without root. If mcopy is not on PATH, build.py runs `apt-get download mtools` + `dpkg -x` into .pi-image/tools/mtools (no sudo). Or install it: sudo apt install mtools
